slides.headline: Meta One launches this month
slides.body: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp bundle AI features behind a monthly fee starting September 2025.

slides.headline: Price starts at $14.99 monthly
slides.body: Ad-free browsing, priority support, and Meta AI assistant access cost more than Netflix Standard.

slides.headline: Free users become the product
slides.body: Non-payers keep ads, data tracking, and slower AI responses — your attention stays the currency.

slides.headline: Two-tier internet arrives
slides.body: Privacy and better AI now require a subscription; critics warn this splits the web by income.

slides.headline: Follow for AI money moves
slides.body: We track who charges, who pays, and what it means for your wallet.
